title.suggested: Sparrer Cut With Glass at Tom Allen's Champions' Retreat

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that William Reed, knocked down twice by performer Mark Tuohy in a challenge bout at Tom Allen's "Champions' Retreat," 619 Market street, broke a window and cut Tuohy about the head with the glass.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 26, 1892, page 6.

facts.fact: Allen's place at 619 Market Street was called the "Champions' Retreat" and engaged song-and-dance sparrer Mark Tuohy
William Reed cut performer Mark Tuohy with window glass after losing a challenge bout at Allen's Champions' Retreat

notes: Allen is the venue owner only; he takes no part in the incident.
